subject: FinTechCo deployment mode qualification: SSO / KMS (BYOK/HSM) / logging retention
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Subject: FinTechCo kickoff recap — deployment mode follow-up (SSO / KMS / logging)

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Summary of requirements we heard:
- SSO: FinTechCo uses Okta and requires SAML 2.0 integration (IdP-initiated and SP-initiated). SCIM for user provisioning would be a plus.
- Key management: you need BYOK with a hardware-backed key (HSM) and customer-managed rotation policies.
- Logging / retention: regulated audit trails, retention for 7 years for certain transaction logs, with exportable, tamper-evident archives.
- Data residency: US-east preferred; possibility of on-premise proof-of-concept for high-sensitivity workloads.

Initial notes on deployment modes (hosted / dedicated / private):
- Hosted API: fastest to production but limited for BYOK/HSM and long-term immutable audit archives.
- Dedicated capacity: gives isolated GPU pools and stronger throughput SLAs; may support tighter networking and longer logging retention but BYOK/HSM depends on KMS integrations.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): most flexible for BYOK/HSM and long retention/audit requirements, supports private control plane and customer KMS/HSM connectors.

Requested next steps:
1) Can you confirm the required KMS provider (e.g., AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, Vault HSM)? Any existing HSM vendor?
2) Which exact classes of logs need 7-year retention (inference request logs, full request+response payloads, or just meta-audit events)?
3) Is procurement the right contact for contract/security terms? If so, please loop procurement@fintechco.com.
4) I’ll follow up with a short note to our infra and security leads (cc’d) to check feasibility and propose a recommended deployment.

Attached: redwood-product-architectural-diagram.pdf and SOC2-SSO-checklist.xlsx for reference.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Thanks Marissa — quick clarifications:
- KMS/HSM: we currently use AWS KMS for most workloads but have an on-prem Thales Luna HSM for our payment vault. For production we need the option to bring a customer key into either cloud KMS or connect to our on-prem HSM for key operations (sign/decrypt).
- Logs: compliance requires 7-year retention for transaction-level audit logs (these include request metadata + redacted response summaries). We cannot retain full PII in logs; must support redaction filters before long-term archive.
- Procurement: yes, procurement is the right group for contract language. I’ve cc’d procurement@fintechco.com. They’ll likely want to see evidence around KMS integration, SOC2 artifacts, and an SLA for data availability.

Next meeting: we’d like a 30-min follow-up next week to review options (Dedicated vs Private) and see a short checklist of gaps. Can you propose 2 slots?

Best —

Marissa — forwarding the thread with my quick take.

On Thu, Jul 15, 2026 at 09:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> (summary omitted)

My assessment:
- BYOK/HSM: Our Hosted API does not support customer-supplied HSM attachments. Dedicated capacity can integrate with cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS / Azure KV) via customer-managed keys, but for direct on-prem HSM connections we need Private (VPC) or an on-prem package.
- Logging & retention: We can extend retention windows on Dedicated for up to X months in our managed storage, but 7 years with tamper-evidence and redaction pipelines is only realistic with Private (customer-managed archive buckets or on-prem archival).
- SSO: SAML + SCIM is supported across all modes; provisioning automation is slightly easier in Dedicated/Private.

Recommendation: Push Private as the default for compliance-facing production. For a phased approach: start with Dedicated for non-sensitive workloads (fast ramp) and plan a Private deployment for payment vaults and any Paxos-level regulated flows.

Action items for our side:
- Vivek: can your infra team confirm effort to support Thales HSM proxying (on-prem HSM -> Redwood edge) and whether we need an on-prem connector?
- Marissa: schedule a 30-min technical readout with Priya + procurement and bring our solutions architect.
- Rishi: prepare an initial gap doc comparing Dedicated vs Private for BYOK/HSM and retention (1 pager).

Thanks —
